title: $1,000 in Amazon in 2001 is now worth this
caption:
In 2001, Amazon was surviving the dot-com crash.
$1,000 in it then would be worth about {growth:AMZN:2001-01-02} today (price growth only, no dividends).
comment: What would you have done with Amazon in 2001? 👇
sources: Amazon price history, Yahoo Finance (split-adjusted), at render time

scenes.say: In 2001, Amazon was surviving the dot-com crash.
Say you put in one thousand dollars.
Watch what it turns into. Today, it would be worth about {growth:AMZN:2001-01-02}.
Time in the market does the heavy lifting.
